SELECT C.CSR_ID AS csrId, C.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_CSR_SYS CS WHERE CS.CSR_ID = C.CSR_ID) AS sysCnt, C.TITLE AS title, C.CSR_TYPE AS csrType, TC.CODE_NM AS csrTypeNm, C.CSR_SUB_TYPE AS csrSubType, STC.CODE_NM AS csrSubTypeNm, C.PRIORITY AS priority, PC.CODE_NM AS priorityNm, C.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, C.REQ_ID AS reqId, TO_CHAR(C.REQ_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reqDt FROM OPS_CSR C LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON C.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'CSR_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = C.STATUS LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE TC ON TC.CODE_GRP = 'CSR_TYPE' AND TC.CODE_ID = C.CSR_TYPE LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE STC ON STC.CODE_GRP = 'CSR_SUBTYPE' AND STC.CODE_ID = C.CSR_SUB_TYPE LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE PC ON PC.CODE_GRP = 'PRIORITY' AND PC.CODE_ID = C.PRIORITY WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY C.CSR_ID DESC OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{recordCountPerPage} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_CSR C WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT C.CSR_ID AS csrId, C.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, C.TITLE AS title, C.CONTENT AS content, C.CSR_TYPE AS csrType, TC.CODE_NM AS csrTypeNm, C.CSR_SUB_TYPE AS csrSubType, STC.CODE_NM AS csrSubTypeNm, C.PRIORITY AS priority, PC.CODE_NM AS priorityNm, C.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, C.REQ_ID AS reqId, TO_CHAR(C.REQ_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reqDt, C.CHARGER_ID AS chargerId, C.PROC_CONTENT AS procContent, TO_CHAR(C.PROC_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS procDt, C.LINKED_TYPE AS linkedType, C.LINKED_ID AS linkedId, C.SATISFACTION AS satisfaction, TO_CHAR(C.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS regDt FROM OPS_CSR C LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON C.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'CSR_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = C.STATUS LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE TC ON TC.CODE_GRP = 'CSR_TYPE' AND TC.CODE_ID = C.CSR_TYPE LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE STC ON STC.CODE_GRP = 'CSR_SUBTYPE' AND STC.CODE_ID = C.CSR_SUB_TYPE LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE PC ON PC.CODE_GRP = 'PRIORITY' AND PC.CODE_ID = C.PRIORITY WHERE C.CSR_ID = #{csrId}

SELECT H.HIS_ID AS hisId, H.CSR_ID AS csrId, H.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, H.CONTENT AS content, H.PROC_ID AS procId, TO_CHAR(H.PROC_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS procDt FROM OPS_CSR_HIS H LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'CSR_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = H.STATUS WHERE H.CSR_ID = #{csrId} ORDER BY H.HIS_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_CSR (SYS_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, CSR_TYPE, CSR_SUB_TYPE, PRIORITY, STATUS, REQ_ID, REQ_DT, CHARGER_ID, LINKED_TYPE, LINKED_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{sysId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{csrType}, #{csrSubType}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{reqId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{chargerId}, #{linkedType}, #{linkedId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE OPS_CSR SET SYS_ID = #{sysId}, TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, CSR_TYPE = #{csrType}, CSR_SUB_TYPE = #{csrSubType}, PRIORITY = #{priority}, CHARGER_ID = #{chargerId} WHERE CSR_ID = #{csrId}
UPDATE OPS_CSR SET STATUS = #{status}, PROC_CONTENT = #{procContent}, CHARGER_ID = #{chargerId}, PROC_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE CSR_ID = #{csrId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_CSR_HIS (CSR_ID, STATUS, CONTENT, PROC_ID, PROC_DT) VALUES (#{csrId}, #{status}, #{content}, #{procId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT CS.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm FROM OPS_CSR_SYS CS LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON S.SYS_ID = CS.SYS_ID WHERE CS.CSR_ID = #{csrId} ORDER BY S.SYS_NM, CS.SYS_ID

SELECT SC.CODE_ID AS subType, SC.CODE_NM AS subTypeNm, SC.UPPER_CODE AS csrType, TC.CODE_NM AS csrTypeNm, T.CONTENT AS content, COALESCE(T.USE_AT, 'Y') AS useAt FROM OPS_CODE SC LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE TC ON TC.CODE_GRP = 'CSR_TYPE' AND TC.CODE_ID = SC.UPPER_CODE LEFT JOIN OPS_CSR_TPL T ON T.SUB_TYPE = SC.CODE_ID WHERE SC.CODE_GRP = 'CSR_SUBTYPE' AND SC.USE_AT = 'Y' ORDER BY TC.SORT_ORDR, SC.SORT_ORDR
SELECT SUB_TYPE AS subType, CONTENT AS content FROM OPS_CSR_TPL WHERE USE_AT = 'Y' AND CONTENT IS NOT NULL

SELECT SC.CODE_ID AS subType, SC.CODE_NM AS subTypeNm, SC.UPPER_CODE AS csrType, TC.CODE_NM AS csrTypeNm, T.CONTENT AS content, COALESCE(T.USE_AT, 'Y') AS useAt FROM OPS_CODE SC LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE TC ON TC.CODE_GRP = 'CSR_TYPE' AND TC.CODE_ID = SC.UPPER_CODE LEFT JOIN OPS_CSR_TPL T ON T.SUB_TYPE = SC.CODE_ID WHERE SC.CODE_GRP = 'CSR_SUBTYPE' AND SC.CODE_ID = #{subType}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_CSR_TPL (SUB_TYPE, CONTENT, USE_AT, REG_DT) VALUES (#{subType}, #{content}, #{useAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
